aula.objetivo: Use the irregular forms of the simple past (ser/ir, ter, estar, fazer, dizer, poder, querer, saber, pôr, ver, vir, dar, trazer) to tell what happened, where you went and what you did, in real conversations.

itens.pt: to go for a walk or a ride

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: some of the most frequent verbs are irregular in the past. You learn them as whole forms, because the stem changes. The endings also differ from the regular ones: the «eu» form ends in -i or -e and the third person has no -ou. STEP 2: «ser» and «ir» share the same past: «fui, foi, foi, fomos, foram». Only the context tells them apart: «Eu fui professor» (I was a teacher, from ser) and «Eu fui ao mercado» (I went to the market, from ir). STEP 3: «ter» becomes «tive, teve, teve, tivemos, tiveram». «Ontem eu tive uma reunião.» (Yesterday I had a meeting.) STEP 4: «estar» becomes «estive, esteve, esteve, estivemos, estiveram». It is used for presence in a place: «Estive em Salvador no ano passado.» STEP 5: with «ir» the preposition is «a» (ao, à) in careful speech, but in daily Brazilian speech people say «Fui no mercado» and «Fui na praia». Both are fine; use «ao/à» in writing. With a destination such as «casa» or a city, use «para» or nothing: «Fui para casa», «Fui a São Paulo». STEP 6: «foi» can be ser or ir, and only the sentence tells you which: «Como foi a festa?» is about ser (How was the party?), «Ela foi à festa» is about ir (She went to the party).
blocos.comparacao: English also has an irregular past for the most common verbs (go, went; have, had; be, was). In Portuguese the same happens, with a twist: ser (to be) and ir (to go) share one past form, «fui», so «I was» and «I went» can look the same. Note that the English «I was in Paris» is «Eu estive em Paris», not «fui».

exemplos.ru: Eu fui à praia no domingo.
exemplos.pt: I went to the beach on Sunday.

exemplos.ru: A gente teve uma festa em casa.
exemplos.pt: We had a party at home.

exemplos.ru: Ela esteve no Rio na semana passada.
exemplos.pt: She was in Rio last week.
They went to the cinema yesterday.

erros.motivo: The «eu» form of ser and ir is «fui».
A past time word needs the past: tive.

erros.errado: Eu estava em Salvador (for a past visit)
erros.motivo: A finished stay uses «estive». «Estava» is for a background situation (lesson 21).

blocos.enunciado: Say where you went last weekend and what you had (a party, a meeting, a trip). Use «fui», «tive» and «estive» at least once.
blocos.exemplo: No sábado eu fui a uma festa. No domingo eu estive em casa e tive muito trabalho.

blocos.enunciado: Tell what you did last weekend with three regular verbs in the past (falar, comer, almoçar, assistir...). Example: «No sábado eu almocei com a minha avó.»
